findings.message: settled-WOT lambda runs lean by +0.069 (above the +0.05 High line)
findings.title: Lambda

findings.message: PUT overshoots setpoint by +11.6 kPa near 3580 rpm (below the +20 kPa High line); primary zone — transient spike at 3580-3631 rpm: mean +11.6 / peak +11.6 kPa over 0.08 s (pull 5)
findings.title: Boost tracking

findings.message: PUT runs 4.9 kPa under setpoint on average (peak -8.9 kPa) for 4.72 s from 3699-6186 rpm (pull 5); the wastegate integral winds from -1.3% to 14.8% across the zone while the final command sits 15.9 points above the position feedforward (`wg_pos_base`) — the closed loop is carrying a shortfall the position feedforward is leaving, so the feedforward is commanding too little there
findings.title: Boost shortfall

findings.message: minor knock retard to -3.0 deg (below the -3.0 deg High line)
findings.title: Knock retard

findings.message: fuel headroom watch: worst DI rail sag -4.8 bar; LPFP duty peaks 81.5%; HPFP eff. volume peaks 96.6%
findings.title: Rail pressure and pump headroom

findings.message: heat/turbo watch: turbo speed peaks 204 krpm; IAT peaks 34 C; coolant peaks 100 C; oil peaks 111 C
findings.title: Turbo and heat

findings.message: demanded manifold-pressure setpoint peak (map_sp) 314.7 kPa stays under the `C_PRS_IM_SP_MAX` ceiling 35000.0 kPa (margin 34685.3 kPa)
findings.title: Boost vs calibrated ceiling

findings.message: logged PUT-minus-ambient peaks 1908 hPa, under the `IP_PUT_AMP_DIF_MAX_PRS_DIF_THR` P0234 threshold 2700 hPa (margin 792 hPa)
findings.title: P0234 overboost margin
